stage: Phase 3a-B fix planning: challenge side bias and line-up strength diagnosis (Owner ruling 2026-10-28 item 3)
status: registered; diagnostic only; runnable after the independent review (review.reviewedAt + an APPROVE verdict) and a passing --validate; never changes the challenge side bias STOP, never a release PASS
authority: Owner 2026-10-28 item 3: open a separate challenge side bias / line-up balance work item; first separate map configuration, team strength, skills / growth curve and engine order; no red/blue numeric compensation
question: challenge.v20 -> challenge.v21 changes five layer groups at once. Which group moves (a) the strength-cancelled side term S and (b) the two pairings whose challenger win rate flipped (drill_mirror>drill_topheavy -23.0pp, drill_rotation>drill_balanced +30.3pp)?
semantics: src/ is not modified. Every arm is assembled from the official challenge.v20 and challenge.v21 MatchSetups of the same seed and orientation (buildChallengeMatchSetup); the tool copies whole layer groups from the v21 setup into a copy of the v20 setup (ruleset.layers plus the matching effectiveLayers / objectiveLayout fields) and runs the official assembleMatch and the runChallenge tick loop. The copy is tool-only: it never reaches production and is not a new ruleset.

layerGroups.frame: tacticalDirector absent -> core.v1 and laneFrame legacyMirror -> teamRelative (the Tactical AI layer; with legacy challenge tactics core.v1 has no per-phase choices, V3 checks it equals static)
layerGroups.growth: heroPassives and heroPowerCurve false -> true (the hero growth curve; both require skills)
layerGroups.layout: objectiveLayout standard -> bySeed (map configuration: SWAPPED seeds get the swapped objective layout)

teamStrength: the line-up / team strength factor is the pairing itself (5 fixed drill pairings) and is cancelled inside each seed by the bidirectional design (t = challenger strength, s = side term); it is reported per pairing, not toggled

arms.L0: challenge.v20 (endpoint, reused: forward records of the committed side bias study, reverse records of the committed bidirectional study)
arms.R_noFrame: v21 minus frame (order + skills + growth + layout): frame effect measured a second time on top of skills (interaction check)

orderStep: frame + order alone (L2) is not run as an arm: V2 must show L2 == L1_frame record-for-record on the validation sample; if V2 fails the run is blocked and the registration goes back to review with L2 as a full arm

steps.layout: L4 - L3_growth (expected exactly 0 on STANDARD seeds; reported as a check)

seeds.rule: the same 2,049 walked seeds as the committed bidirectional study (odd seeds from 33001 up to lastSeed 37097 of side_bias_result_challenge_3aB.json); reused on purpose so every arm is paired with the endpoints; diagnostic reuse, no confirmatory claim
seeds.orientation: each seed is played forward (challenger blue) and reverse (defender blue, tactics swapped, draft assignment mirrored b_i<->r_i), exactly as the bidirectional study

matches: 4 new arms x 2,049 seeds x 2 orientations = 16,392 (about 5.7 h at 1.25 s per match, 3 workers); validation about 480 matches

metrics.s: side term per seed = (forward blue win + reverse blue win) / 2; S = mean(s) - 0.5
metrics.t: challenger strength per seed = (forward blue win + (1 - reverse blue win)) / 2
metrics.win: blue win 1, red win 0, no winner at the time limit 0.5

analysis: per arm and per layout stratum (STANDARD / SWAPPED by engine seed): S with 95% CI; per pairing: T with 95% CI
per step and stratum: paired mean of the per-seed difference in s (pp) with 95% CI; per step and pairing: paired mean difference in t (pp) with 95% CI and the difference in s
a step 'moves S' or 'moves T' when its 95% CI excludes 0; z >= 2.73 is reported as a Bonferroni reference over the 5 steps x 2 strata
sequential attribution depends on the ladder order; frame is measured at both ends (frame@v20, frame@v21) and the difference is reported as the interaction
sum check: the step means along L0 -> L1 -> L3a -> L3 -> L4 add up to L4 - L0 per stratum (arithmetic identity)
the committed SWAPPED / STANDARD side verdicts are not re-computed or changed

interpretationMap.MAP_LAYOUT: the layout step moves S on SWAPPED seeds: the side term comes from the map configuration (the dragon-pit side) -> candidate fixes are map / objective-layout work, not numbers
interpretationMap.SKILLS_OR_GROWTH: the skills or growth step moves S: the skill / growth layers act differently by side -> an engine audit of side-dependent paths is needed before any fix (a semantics change)
interpretationMap.FRAME: a frame step moves S: the lane-frame mapping of red lane knobs -> re-check TD-3A-23
interpretationMap.STRENGTH_ONLY: a step moves T of a pairing but not S: a line-up balance question (skills / growth favour some rosters), not a side question
interpretationMap.note: none of these labels authorises a fix; red/blue numeric compensation is excluded by the Owner ruling

validation.V1: ladder ends reproduce the committed records: no groups == L0 and all groups == L4 (win, duration, engine seed) on 20 STANDARD + 20 SWAPPED seeds x 2 orientations
validation.V2: L2 (frame + order) == L1_frame record-for-record on the same sample (otherwise blocked, see orderStep)
validation.V3: frame with tacticalDirector static == frame with core.v1 on the same sample (with legacy tactics core.v1 has no per-phase choices)
validation.V4: endpoint data complete: forward (side bias challenge folder) and reverse (bidirectional folder) records for all 2,049 seeds x both versions, meta = their registrations and the frozen fingerprint
validation.V5: every arm's setup differs from L0 only in the declared layer keys and effectiveLayers / objectiveLayout fields

liveCheck: every record carries its arm, orientation, engine seed and the Director mode / lane frame read from the engine; a mismatch with the arm definition => HALT
errors: errored matches are never retried; a seed with any errored match in any arm is dropped from every comparison and listed; more than 1% errored => STOP(INSTRUMENT)
